explanations.text: Root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) 0.00 A, computed on 12 CA atoms from 12 aligned residues (mobile: design_0_s1 (predicted structure), reference: design_0 (RFdiffusion backbone; no sequence, no confidence)). RMSD measures average positional difference over only those atoms, and is sensitive to outlier regions and to which atoms were selected. Only 12 atoms were aligned, so this RMSD describes a very small part of the structure. TM-score 1.000. TM-score is a length-normalised structural similarity measure between 0 and 1; higher means greater similarity of the aligned backbones. It does not describe function. Model confidence is not evidence of folding, binding, affinity, efficacy, safety, or experimental validation.

limitations: Model confidence is not evidence of folding, binding, affinity, efficacy, safety, or experimental validation.
matrix_convention: 4x4 column-vector transform mapping mobile coordinates into the reference frame
notes: Residue matching was chosen automatically: sequence alignment paired 12 residue(s) at 0% identity, too little to rely on, so residues were paired by residue number instead (12 pairs). This assumes both structures use the same residue numbering.
RMSD depends on which residues are matched; low-confidence or disordered regions are included unless excluded via the selection ranges.
RMSD and TM-score measure geometric similarity only, not function or binding.

procedure: Single optimal rigid-body (Kabsch) superposition of matched CA atoms; no outlier rejection or iterative refinement for RMSD.
